brief: The 6-tool no-code stack that runs my $30K/mo business.

slots.title: WEBFLOW WEBSITES
slots.body: I design and host high-converting landing pages without touching a single line of code. It handles responsive layouts, CMS collections, and SEO like a dream.

slots.title: NOTION HQ
slots.body: This is my brain. I run my content calendar, client portals, and SOPs in one spot so nothing falls through the cracks.

slots.title: AIRTABLE CRM
slots.body: I track every lead, project stage, and deliverable in colorful linked bases. It’s basically my sales team minus the salary.

slots.title: MAKE AUTOMATIONS
slots.body: Make connects my apps so invoices, welcome emails, and Slack alerts happen while I sleep. Zero manual nonsense.

slots.title: STRIPE PAYMENTS
slots.body: Checkout links and subscription billing keep cash flowing in on autopilot. Getting paid has never felt this easy.

slots.title: CONVERTKIT EMAILS
slots.body: I nurture leads and launch products with automated sequences and simple broadcasts. My audience actually opens them.
